title: Jobs
subtitle: Track active background tasks and recent outcomes.

backfill_status_unavailable: Status unavailable after a backend restart or session change. The job may have been interrupted.

errors_export_notes_placeholder: What went wrong? Included in the bundle.

errors_health_subtitle: Live system health for your bird detection setup.
errors_backend_diagnostics_desc: The newest the backend has recorded since the error history was last cleared.
errors_no_startup_warnings: No startup warnings captured in the current workspace snapshot.
errors_download_snapshot_desc: Includes workspace health, backend diagnostics, classifier status, startup warnings, incidents, and client context.
errors_notes_placeholder: Optional notes to include when you capture a saved bundle
errors_bundles_local_desc: Distinct snapshots stay local until you download or delete them.
errors_naming_labels_changed: The label file for {models} does not match the checksum it was published with. Species names taken from it are not trustworthy.
errors_naming_no_reference: No bundled species reference, so names come from the network only.
errors_naming_ok: {count, plural, one {# species can be named without the network.} other {# species can be named without the network.}}
errors_naming_catalog_missing: No species catalogue yet. Names come from the bundled reference and model label files.
errors_naming_catalog_empty: The species catalogue is empty. Names come from the bundled reference and model label files.
errors_naming_catalog_gaps: {unresolved} model output classes have no catalogue identity yet and keep their original label text.
errors_naming_catalog_ok: Every mapped model output resolves to a catalogue identity.
errors_catalog_rollback: The catalogue is a separate file from your detection history. Rolling one back changes names, never your recorded sightings, and a backup of the data directory covers both.
errors_summary_healthy: All monitored services look healthy right now.
errors_summary_degraded: Some subsystems are under pressure or recovering, but the app is still serving traffic.
errors_summary_faults: The app is reporting active faults that need attention.
errors_pipeline_ok: The ingest pipeline is processing detections normally.
errors_pipeline_critical: {count, plural, one {# critical failure recorded.} other {# critical failures recorded.}}
errors_pipeline_historical: {count, plural, one {# historical failure recorded; pipeline has since recovered.} other {# historical failures recorded; pipeline has since recovered.}}

errors_filtered_none: Nothing has been filtered out yet.
errors_filtered_summary: {count, plural, one {# detection did not meet your detection settings.} other {# detections did not meet your detection settings.}} This is the filter working, not a fault.
errors_filtered_hint: Adjust the naming threshold in Settings → Detection to keep more of these.
errors_activity_subtitle: Recorded visits, filtered detections and pipeline faults, in the order they happened
errors_activity_no_window: This instance has not reported when it started, so activity cannot be placed in a window yet.
errors_activity_empty: No detection activity has been reported since this instance started {started} ago.
errors_activity_earlier: {count, plural, one {# earlier event in this window} other {# earlier events in this window}}
errors_fault_preview: Preview the failed detection frame for {species}
errors_filtered_frame_gone: Frigate no longer has this frame

errors_drop_reason_row.filter_low_confidence: Not recorded, below your naming threshold

errors_drop_reason_row.filter_out_of_range: Not recorded, never seen in your eBird region

frigate_media_advisory_title: Frigate often has no snapshot for a detection
frigate_media_advisory_body: {percent}% of recent detections ({dropped} of {started}) were dropped because Frigate had no snapshot, thumbnail, or recording for them. This usually means briefly-tracked birds that never persist as Frigate events, or short recording retention.
errors_mqtt_pressure: MQTT handlers are under {pressure} pressure at {inFlight}/{capacity} in flight.
errors_mqtt_reconnected: MQTT recovered cleanly after {count, plural, one {# topic reconnect} other {# topic reconnects}}.
errors_live_class_ok: Live classification capacity is currently clear.
errors_live_class_recovering: Live classification is recovering while {running}/{maxConcurrent} slots are active.
errors_live_class_queued: {queued} live items are queued behind {running}/{maxConcurrent} active slots.
errors_background_throttled: Background work is throttled with {queued} items waiting.
errors_dispatcher_ok: Notification dispatch and DB pool look healthy.
errors_dispatcher_dropped: Notification dispatcher dropped {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}.
errors_startup_ok: No startup warnings are currently recorded.
errors_startup_summary: {count, plural, one {# startup warning recorded.} other {# startup warnings recorded.}} Latest phase: {phase}.
circuit_open_detail: {queued} queued items are waiting. Recent failures: {failures}.
more_lanes: +{count, plural, one {# more work lane} other {# more work lanes}}
errors_summary_connections_unread: Nothing inside YA-WAMF reports a fault, but the MQTT broker and Frigate connections could not be read.
errors_connections_unread: The connection could not be read. Refresh to try again.
errors_mqtt_disconnected: Not connected to {server}. Last tried {at}; it keeps retrying.

errors_frigate_failure.timeout: it took too long to answer
errors_frigate_failure.server_error: it reported an error of its own
errors_frigate_failure.connection: the address could not be reached

errors_frigate_unreachable: Frigate at {url} did not answer at {at}: {reason}.
errors_frigate_unchecked: Frigate at {url} has not been asked anything since this instance started.
errors_frigate_announced_online: Frigate announces itself online over MQTT.
errors_frigate_announced_offline: Frigate announces itself offline over MQTT.
errors_pipeline_idle: No detections have reached the pipeline since this instance started.

errors_problem.mqtt_down: The MQTT broker at {server} is not connected, so no new detections can arrive.
errors_problem.mqtt_down_next: Check its address in Settings → Connection and that the broker is running.
errors_problem.mqtt_not_configured: No MQTT broker is set, so no detections can arrive.
errors_problem.mqtt_stopped: The MQTT service is not running, so no new detections can arrive.
errors_problem.mqtt_stopped_next: Restart YA-WAMF to start it again.
errors_problem.frigate_down: Frigate at {url} is not answering, so new detections cannot be saved.
errors_problem.frigate_down_next: Check its address in Settings → Connection and that Frigate is running.

errors_clear_effect: Removes recorded errors and incidents now. Live checks carry on.
earlier_incidents_desc: Problems that have since cleared. What is open now is listed with the system status above.
earlier_incidents_empty: Nothing has cleared since the error history was last cleared.
global_queued_only: {count, plural, one {# job queued} other {# jobs queued}}
errors_read_failed: The health reading could not be loaded, so this page claims no state.
errors_read_failed_next: Refresh to try again. If it keeps failing, check that the YA-WAMF backend is running.
errors_read_stale: The latest refresh failed, so this is the reading from {at}. Refresh to try again.
errors_pipeline_unmeasured: Nothing can arrive while the MQTT broker is not connected, so these counts do not show whether the pipeline works.
errors_mqtt_cause_unknown: The broker client gave a reason YA-WAMF does not recognise. It is shown under Technical details.
errors_video_paused_until: Video analysis is paused until {at}, after {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row.
errors_video_paused: Video analysis is paused after {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row.
errors_video_not_paused: Video analysis is not paused: {queued} waiting, {running} running.
errors_summary_unknown: This reading did not say whether YA-WAMF is working, so no state is claimed.
errors_subsystems_unread: Nothing to show until a health reading has loaded.
errors_activity_unread: Activity cannot be shown until a health reading has loaded.
errors_clear_failed: The error history could not be cleared. Try again.

classify_snapshot_timeout.title: A detection was dropped because naming its snapshot took too long.
classify_snapshot_timeout.next: The classifier may be overloaded. Check Resource use above, or choose a lighter model in Settings → Models.

classify_snapshot_overloaded.title: A detection was dropped because the classifier was too busy.
classify_snapshot_overloaded.next: Check Resource use above. If it happens often, choose a lighter model in Settings → Models.

classify_snapshot_unavailable.title: A detection was dropped because Frigate had no snapshot for it.
classify_snapshot_unavailable.next: Check that snapshots are turned on for this camera in Frigate.

classifier_empty_results.title: A detection was dropped because the classifier gave no answer.
classifier_empty_results.next: Check that a model is loaded in Settings → Models.

save_and_notify_failed.title: A detection was named but could not be saved.
save_and_notify_failed.next: Check that the data folder has free space and can be written to.

stale_job.title: A background job stopped making progress.
stale_job.next: It is shown on Notifications. Start it again from there, or from the Settings tab that runs it.

generic.title: A processing step failed. Technical details have the exact error.

stage_failure.title: A detection could not be processed because one of its steps failed.
stage_failure.next: If it keeps happening, copy the Technical details into a GitHub issue.

stage_timeout.title: A detection step took too long and was stopped.
stage_timeout.next: The classifier or Frigate may be overloaded. Check Resource use above.
